feeding_claim.verbatim: our beef is 100% grass-fed from birth through finishing

local_areas: west, northwest and north Chicago suburbs

resold_note: Also sells milk, yogurt, kefir, cheese and butter plus pantry goods from partner farms and makers.
notes: Family farm southwest of Marengo with a farm store open Monday and Wednesday 9 to 5 and Saturday 9 to 2. Checked 2026-11-15: homepage, farming practices, FAQ and shop pages. The homepage says the beef is 100% grass-fed from birth through finishing, but the shop also sells 1/2 and 1/4 Grain-Finished Beef shares next to the 100% grass-fed shares, so the category is both; the site does not say where the grain-finished cattle come from. Hogs and chickens get non-GMO grain feed with soy. Hand delivery to west, northwest and north Chicago suburbs and north city neighborhoods, plus pickup at the farm store, the Palatine Farmers Market (Saturdays, order by Thursday) and a Skokie taproom. No shipping found. Shop dairy carries other brands (Prairie Pure, Graziers), so no dairy species is added.
